name: Sew a feather stitch that alternates sides
description: Work a band of loops that sit under one another, offset to the left and then the right.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew a feather stitch that alternates sides.

levels.name: Offset one loop to the right
levels.completion_criterion: Bring the needle up, take it down to the right, and come up inside the loop so it tightens into a V.
levels.can_do: Offset one loop to the right
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Offset the next to the left
levels.completion_criterion: Make the next loop on the other side of the line, under the first.
levels.can_do: Offset the next to the left
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Keep alternating
levels.completion_criterion: Continue a short band in which the loops change side each time.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

name: Fill a shape with long and short stitches
description: Cover a small shape with straight stitches of uneven length, then start the next row by splitting those stitches.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fill a shape with long and short stitches.

levels.name: Vary the first edge
levels.completion_criterion: Lay several straight stitches over one edge of a small shape, and make their lengths differ.
levels.safety_requirements: A split-stitch outline is optional. Sew on scrap. This is not a claim that the shading matches a picture.

levels.name: Do the other side
levels.completion_criterion: Fill the other side of that edge the same way, still changing the length.
levels.safety_requirements: A split-stitch outline is optional. Sew on scrap. This is not a claim that the shading matches a picture.

levels.name: Split into the next row
levels.completion_criterion: Bring the needle up through a stitch of the first row, not all at the same point, and lay the next stitch.
levels.safety_requirements: A split-stitch outline is optional. Sew on scrap. This is not a claim that the shading matches a picture.

safety_notes: A split-stitch outline is optional. Sew on scrap. This is not a claim that the shading matches a picture.

name: Shade a patch with seed stitches
description: Scatter tiny straight stitches in different directions, and make one area denser than another.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Shade a patch with seed stitches.

levels.name: Scatter a few seeds
levels.completion_criterion: Make several straight stitches, each only a millimetre or two long, pointing different ways.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Density is the shading. Do not claim a species or a picture.

levels.name: Pack one patch
levels.completion_criterion: Place stitches close together in one part of a small shape.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Density is the shading. Do not claim a species or a picture.

levels.name: Leave another patch open
levels.completion_criterion: Spread stitches farther apart beside it, and say which patch looks darker.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Density is the shading. Do not claim a species or a picture.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Density is the shading. Do not claim a species or a picture.

name: Fold an omelette while the centre is soft
description: Beat eggs, cook them in foaming butter, pull the set edge so liquid fills the gap, and fold while the centre is still soft.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fold an omelette while the centre is soft.

levels.name: Mix and foam the butter
levels.completion_criterion: Beat the eggs until the white is mixed through, and heat the butter until it foams and has not browned.
levels.safety_requirements: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the basic folded omelette from the opened recipe, not a medical claim about undercooked eggs.

levels.name: Pull the set edge
levels.completion_criterion: Pour the eggs in, tilt the pan so they cover the base, and pull a set edge so liquid egg runs into the gap.
levels.safety_requirements: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the basic folded omelette from the opened recipe, not a medical claim about undercooked eggs.

levels.name: Fold and plate
levels.completion_criterion: When the egg has just set and the centre is still soft, fold it and slide it onto a plate.
levels.safety_requirements: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the basic folded omelette from the opened recipe, not a medical claim about undercooked eggs.

safety_notes: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the basic folded omelette from the opened recipe, not a medical claim about undercooked eggs.

name: Say how the buds are arranged and stop
description: On one winter twig, say whether the side buds are opposite, alternate, or spiral, and do not name a species from that alone.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Say how the buds are arranged and stop.

levels.name: Find the side buds
levels.completion_criterion: Point to buds along the twig, not only the bud at the tip.
levels.safety_requirements: Look, do not pick buds from a tree you may not touch. Do not eat any part.

levels.name: Name the arrangement
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether they sit in opposite pairs, alternate from side to side, or spiral around the twig.
levels.safety_requirements: Look, do not pick buds from a tree you may not touch. Do not eat any part.

levels.name: Stop without a species
levels.completion_criterion: If you have only that arrangement, do not name the tree. A species needs a second clue you can point to.
levels.safety_requirements: Look, do not pick buds from a tree you may not touch. Do not eat any part.

safety_notes: Look, do not pick buds from a tree you may not touch. Do not eat any part.

name: Tell needles from scales
description: On a conifer, say whether the foliage is separate needles or overlapping scales, and remember that larch can be bare in winter.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Tell needles from scales.

levels.name: Find the foliage
levels.completion_criterion: Point to growth that is needles or scales rather than a broad blade.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not pull foliage from a protected tree. Do not eat cones or berries.

levels.name: Choose
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether you see separate needles or flattened scales that overlap.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not pull foliage from a protected tree. Do not eat cones or berries.

levels.name: Name the limit
levels.completion_criterion: Say that a bare twig is not proof against larch, which drops its needles.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not pull foliage from a protected tree. Do not eat cones or berries.

safety_notes: Do not pull foliage from a protected tree. Do not eat cones or berries.
